Container.Name: oci-monitor
Container.Overview: Monitors OCI free tier resource usage and costs. Sends Telegram alerts when spend thresholds are breached, load balancers exceed limits, or orphaned resources are detected. Supports auto-cleanup and on-demand status via Telegram bot commands.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent state storage.

Config.Name: OCI Tenancy OCID
Config.Description: Tenancy root OCID (ocid1.tenancy.oc1..)

Config.Name: OCI User OCID
Config.Description: API user OCID (ocid1.user.oc1..)

Config.Name: OCI Fingerprint
Config.Description: API key fingerprint (xx:xx:xx:..)

Config.Name: OCI Region
Config.Description: OCI home region identifier.

Config.Name: OCI API Key (PEM)
Config.Description: Full PEM private key content including its header and footer.

Config.Name: OCI Compartment OCID
Config.Description: Compartment for cleanup/storage checks. Compute scans all accessible compartments and falls back to this compartment if discovery fails.

Config.Name: Telegram Bot Token
Config.Description: Bot token from @BotFather.

Config.Name: Telegram Chat ID
Config.Description: Chat or user ID to send alerts to.

Config.Name: Cost Threshold (GBP)
Config.Description: Monthly spend threshold in GBP before alerting.

Config.Name: Max Load Balancers
Config.Description: Max allowed active load balancers.

Config.Name: Max Free Public IPs
Config.Description: Unassigned reserved IPs before alerting (OCI free tier: 2).

Config.Name: Max Object Storage (GB)
Config.Description: Object Storage alert threshold in GB (free tier limit: 20 GB).

Config.Name: Max Ampere Instances
Config.Description: Max Always Free Ampere A1 instances.

Config.Name: Max Ampere OCPUs
Config.Description: Max total Always Free Ampere A1 OCPUs.

Config.Name: Max Ampere Memory (GB)
Config.Description: Max total Always Free Ampere A1 memory in GB.

Config.Name: Max E2 Micro Instances
Config.Description: Max Always Free E2 Micro instances.

Config.Name: Alert on Change Only
Config.Description: Non-threshold findings alert only when they first appear, change, or clear.

Config.Name: Check Interval (hours)
Config.Description: How often to run checks.

Config.Name: OCI State Bucket
Config.Description: Object Storage bucket name for persisting state and cleanup reports (optional).

Config.Name: Account Label
Config.Description: Display name shown in alerts — defaults to compartment name (optional).
